## Context

Scheduled reports accumulate. Each one costs a warehouse query on every run and nobody ever
retires them, so the bill grows without anyone deciding it should.

There is no repo to change here — the answer is a list, and then a conversation about it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A list of every scheduled report, with its schedule, last-opened date, and owner.
- [ ] Anything not opened in 90 days is flagged, not deleted.
- [ ] The findings land as a note on this ticket; the decision to retire is the operator's.

## Out of scope

- Actually deleting anything.
